releaseNotes:
Rookline 0.6.23 adds configurable Mixed, class and Top 8 Each Drive tower views, readable timing headings, completed-lap colours, sector and finish states, controller bindings, prominent sourced penalties and matching mixed-tyre dots. Optional manufacturer work is batched and Drive tyre requests omit unused setup reads.

Rookline installs and runs independently. RookForce is a separate optional application with its own installation and interface.

The Windows installer is not Authenticode-signed. Rookline verifies its published SHA-256 and version through this HTTPS manifest before updater launch. No new installed-upgrade, native game-performance or hardware validation is claimed.
